verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's own docs offer a JSON Output mode that guarantees syntactically valid JSON strings, which covers the 'no fragile parsing' core of the story. The evidence does not show JSON-schema-constrained responses or a natively typed answer format, so only valid-JSON mode is evidenced. Missing for 10: JSON-schema-constrained output, typed or structured response format beyond valid JSON, in-depth docs on schema adherence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get typed, structured outputs — JSON-schema-constrained responses or a natively typed answer format — so my code consumes model output without fragile parsing

citations.quote: DeepSeek provides JSON Output to ensure the model outputs valid JSON strings.
